import { mutation, query } from "./_generated/server";
import { components, internal } from "./_generated/api";
import { v } from "convex/values";
import { hashBrowserCode } from "@disposabl/disposabl-kit/server/browser-session";

// Disposable backend only: force an existing synthetic handoff or return to expire.
export const expire = mutation({
  args: {
    code: v.string(),
    field: v.union(v.literal("handoff"), v.literal("return")),
  },
  returns: v.null(),
  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
    const hash = await hashBrowserCode(args.code);
    const row = await ctx.db
      .query("billingHandoffs")
      .withIndex("by_hash", (q) => q.eq("hash", hash))
      .unique();
    if (!row) throw new Error("Fixture handoff missing.");
    await ctx.db.patch(
      "billingHandoffs",
      row._id,
      args.field === "handoff" ? { expiresAt: 0 } : { returnExpiresAt: 0 },
    );
    return null;
  },
});

// A public fixture marker and environment fence; this file must never reach a real deployment.
export const ready = query({
  args: {},
  returns: v.boolean(),
  handler: async () => {
    const providers = [
      process.env.BOAT_API_KEY,
      process.env.R2_ACCOUNT_ID,
      process.env.R2_BUCKET_NAME,
      process.env.R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID,
      process.env.R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY,
      process.env.AUTUMN_SECRET_KEY,
      process.env.REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_AUTH,
      process.env.RESEND_API_KEY,
      process.env.AUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET,
      process.env.CONVEX_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET,
      process.env.GITHUB_CONNECTOR,
      process.env.VERCEL_TOKEN,
      process.env.CONNECTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY,
      process.env.POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN,
    ];
    return (
      process.env.E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED === "1" &&
      providers.every((v) => !v?.trim())
    );
  },
});

// Test-only bridge: synthetic users in this disposable database only.
export const removeOwner = mutation({
  args: { userId: v.id("users") },
  returns: v.null(),
  handler: async (ctx, { userId }) => {
    await ctx.db.delete("users", userId);
    return null;
  },
});

// Call the actual registered internal product mutation, with no provider call.
export const beginAttempt = mutation({
  args: { userId: v.string(), requestId: v.string() },
  returns: v.union(
    v.string(),
    v.null(),
    v.object({ retryAllowed: v.literal(true) }),
  ),
  handler: (ctx, { userId, requestId }) =>
    ctx.runMutation(internal.billing.beginAttempt, {
      userId,
      requestId,
      purchase: "topup",
    }),
});
export const hasAttempt = query({
  args: { userId: v.string(), requestId: v.string() },
  returns: v.boolean(),
  handler: async (ctx, { userId, requestId }) =>
    !!(await ctx.db
      .query("billingAttempts")
      .withIndex("by_userId_requestId", (q) =>
        q.eq("userId", userId).eq("requestId", requestId),
      )
      .unique()),
});

// Count Auth component sessions for a synthetic user in the disposable copy.
export const sessionCount = query({
  args: { userId: v.id("users") },
  returns: v.number(),
  handler: async (ctx, { userId }) =>
    (await ctx.runQuery(components.auth.public.listSessions, { userId })).length,
});

// Global fixture-only evidence catches writes under any synthetic identity.
// Refuse an oversized fixture rather than silently ignoring later rows.
export const checkoutRows = query({
  args: {},
  returns: v.object({
    attempts: v.array(v.id("billingAttempts")),
    calls: v.array(v.id("fixtureCheckoutDispatches")),
  }),
  handler: async (ctx) => {
    const [attempts, calls] = await Promise.all([
      ctx.db.query("billingAttempts").order("asc").take(101),
      ctx.db.query("fixtureCheckoutDispatches").order("asc").take(101),
    ]);
    if (attempts.length > 100 || calls.length > 100)
      throw new Error("Fixture evidence exceeds its bounded inventory.");
    return {
      attempts: attempts.map((row) => row._id),
      calls: calls.map((row) => row._id),
    };
  },
});
